1: // Simple Orbital Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11: 
12:   // Resize canvas to fill its container
13:   const resize = () => {
14:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
15:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
16:   };
17:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
18:   resize();
19: 
20:   // Game constants
21:   const PLANET_RADIUS = 30;
22:   const ORBIT_RADIUS = 120; // distance from planet center
23:   const SHIP_SIZE = 12; // length of ship triangle
24:   const ROTATION_STEP = (Math.PI / 12); // 15 degrees per click
25:   const ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED = 0.7;
26:   const ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED = 1.5;
27:   const ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
28:   const MAX_LIVES = 3;
29: 
30:   // Game state
31:   let shipAngle = 0; // angle around planet
32:   let lives = MAX_LIVES;
33:   let lastSpawn = 0;
34:   const asteroids = [];
35:   let gameOver = false;
36: 
37:   // Helper: distance squared
38:   const dist2 = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => {
39:     const dx = x1 - x2;
40:     const dy = y1 - y2;
41:     return dx * dx + dy * dy;
42:   };
43: 
44:   // Ship position (computed each frame)
45:   const getShipPos = () => {
46:     const cx = canvas.width / 2;
47:     const cy = canvas.height / 2;
48:     const x = cx + ORBIT_RADIUS * Math.cos(shipAngle);
49:     const y = cy + ORBIT_RADIUS * Math.sin(shipAngle);
50:     return { x, y };
51:   };
52: 
53:   // Asteroid class
54:   class Asteroid {
55:     constructor() {
56:       // Spawn on a random edge
57:       const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
58:       const margin = 10;
59:       let x, y, vx, vy;
60:       const speed = ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED + Math.random() * (ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED - ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED);
61:       switch (edge) {
62:         case 0: // top
63:           x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
64:           y = -margin;
65:           break;
66:         case 1: // right
67:           x = canvas.width + margin;
68:           y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
69:           break;
70:         case 2: // bottom
71:           x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
72:           y = canvas.height + margin;
73:           break;
74:         case 3: // left
75:           x = -margin;
76:           y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
77:           break;
78:       }
79:       // Aim roughly toward the planet center with a slight random offset for curvature
80:       const targetX = canvas.width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
81:       const targetY = canvas.height / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
82:       const dx = targetX - x;
83:       const dy = targetY - y;
84:       const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
85:       vx = (dx / len) * speed;
86:       vy = (dy / len) * speed;
87:       this.x = x;
88:       this.y = y;
89:       this.vx = vx;
90:       this.vy = vy;
91:       this.radius = 8 + Math.random() * 6;
92:     }
93:     update(dt) {
94:       this.x += this.vx * dt;
95:       this.y += this.vy * dt;
96:     }
97:     draw() {
98:       ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
99:       ctx.beginPath();
100:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
101:       ctx.fill();
102:     }
103:   }
104: 
105:   // Input: click rotates ship clockwise
106:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
107:     if (gameOver) return;
108:     shipAngle += ROTATION_STEP;
109:   });
110: 
111:   // Main loop
112:   let lastTime = performance.now();
113:   function loop(now) {
114:     const dt = (now - lastTime) / 16; // normalize to ~60fps units
115:     lastTime = now;
116:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
117:     render();
118:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
119:   }
120: 
121:   function update(dt) {
122:     // Spawn asteroids
123:     if (now - lastSpawn > ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
124:       asteroids.push(new Asteroid());
125:       lastSpawn = now;
126:     }
127:     // Update asteroids
128:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
129:       const a = asteroids[i];
130:       a.update(dt);
131:       // Remove if far off-screen
132:       if (a.x < -50 || a.x > canvas.width + 50 || a.y < -50 || a.y > canvas.height + 50) {
133:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
134:         continue;
135:       }
136:       // Collision with ship
137:       const shipPos = getShipPos();
138:       if (dist2(a.x, a.y, shipPos.x, shipPos.y) < (a.radius + SHIP_SIZE) ** 2) {
139:         lives--;
140:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
141:         if (lives <= 0) {
142:           gameOver = true;
143:         }
144:       }
145:     }
146:   }
147: 
148:   function render() {
149:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

152:     const cy = canvas.height / 2;
153:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0b3d91';
154:     ctx.beginPath();
155:     ctx.arc(cx, cy, PLANET_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
156:     ctx.fill();
157: 
158:     // Draw ship (triangle pointing outward)
159:     const shipPos = getShipPos();
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
161:     ctx.save();
162:     ctx.translate(shipPos.x, shipPos.y);
163:     ctx.rotate(shipAngle + Math.PI / 2); // point outward
164:     ctx.beginPath();
165:     ctx.moveTo(0, -SHIP_SIZE);
166:     ctx.lineTo(SHIP_SIZE / 2, SHIP_SIZE);
167:     ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_SIZE / 2, SHIP_SIZE);
168:     ctx.closePath();
169:     ctx.fill();
170:     ctx.restore();
171: 
172:     // Draw asteroids
173:     for (const a of asteroids) a.draw();
174: 
175:     // Draw lives
176:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
177:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
178:     ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + lives, 10, 20);
179: 
180:     if (gameOver) {
181:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
182:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
183:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
184:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
185:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
186:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
187:     }
188:   }
189: 
190:   // Start loop
191:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
192: })();
